rows.en:
At that instant, Kazama turned around, and a tremendous noise rang out.
"...What's with you?
You planning to scar my beautiful nape?
What a stupid fool."
The pervert's ghost took a blow from Kazama's elbow and was sent flying into the darkness.
Whoa, amazing.
Was Kazama really a saint after all...?{p}

"I've got a girl I've sworn to spend my future with, you know.
In fact, I've just come from greeting her parents, you know?
Trying to go after someone like me? You're way too naive."
He was saying things that made no sense.
Who on earth is this guy?
Rather than a saint, isn't he just wildly delusional?{p}

...Kazama started walking again.
What should I do?
I've gotten mixed up with an unbelievable person.
Will I be able to live in peace from tomorrow on?
I kept watching his back for a long, long time...{p}

"Ugyah!"
I quickly dodged, and Kazama lost his balance and fell over.{p}

"Oh, come on, I don't have any ulterior motives.
This is to protect you.
It's better if I stay as close to you as I can, right?"
Kazama said it with a leering grin.{p}

I let him hold me.
I leaned against his broad chest.
"{b}, you're so cute.
I'll protect you, I promise.
Let's always walk home like this.
It's easier to protect you when I'm close."
Kazama hugged me tight.
...Hm?
He's leering.{p}

"{b}, what's gotten into you?"
Kazama looked at me, surprised.
"Huh? Was something weird?"
"...Listen.
I didn't put my arm around you so we could sing.
It's to protect you.
When you're walking home on a dark road, it's best to stay as close as possible."
Oh no, silly me.
What a ridiculous misunderstanding.
Right, to protect me... hm?{p}

Kazama tightened his grip on my shoulder.
Ah, he's leering.{p}

Kazama seemed startled by something.
What's the matter with him?{p}

I looked, and Hino was standing in the doorway.
"Not bad, Kazama."
Hino was grinning.
"{a}'s pretty popular in the newspaper club too, you know."
"N-no, it's not like that, Hino! Kazama's just protecting me..."
"Well, never mind.
Everyone, have a seat.
I'm the seventh.
Sorry to keep you waiting.
There was something I wanted to check, so I was late."{p}

"Hino, we were just saying we'd head home."
Kazama was fidgeting.
"Don't be so cold, Kazama.
It'll be over quick."
Hino had everyone sit down and began his story.{p}

"...Here's the thing.
A terrifying man's ghost is lurking around here.
It goes after high school girls and nobody else, slaughtering them over and over.
Why it does that, I don't really know.
That ghost has really nasty eyes.
The air about it is clearly different from a normal person's.
The fact is, I spotted it by the school gate today..."
...Wait a minute.
Isn't Hino's story an awful lot like Kazama's?
Is it the same story?
So there really is a pervert's ghost around here...{p}

"So, Kazama, there's something I want to ask you..."
Hino's face suddenly turned sharp.
"You forgot about this meeting and went home today, didn't you?"
Huh?
"And yet you came here. That means..."{p}

Kazama suddenly got up from his seat.
He dashed toward the door.
"Wait☆"
Hino stood up too.{p}

Kazama slammed the door and left the club room.
"...He ran for it."
Hino frowned.
Without thinking, I grabbed Hino's arm.
"Hino! What's going on?"
"That wasn't Kazama. It was a ghost disguised as Kazama."
"Whaaat?"
"Today I was keeping watch on a strange man's ghost near the school gate, and I saw Kazama heading home.
When I went to follow, the ghost grinned and turned itself into Kazama.
That ghost must have heard about this meeting from somewhere, don't you think?"
...No way☆
I almost went home with that man?{p}

"Wow, that was a close call, huh."
Hosoda gave a wry smile.
Everyone had complicated looks on their faces.
The club room went so quiet you could hear the clock ticking.{p}

"{a}, maybe you'd better head home for today."
Hino patted me on the shoulder.
One after another, everyone nodded to each other.
...So ghosts really do exist.
When I said that, Arai looked down and muttered.{p}

We all walked to the school gate together.
"Well, everyone, be careful."
Hino told us.
In the end, it was decided that each girl would be walked home by someone who lived near her.
I was going home with Hino.{p}

"{a}, let's go."
...I'm worn out today.
We walked in silence for a while.
...Huh?
I feel someone's strange gaze on me...{p}

Hino was looking at me.
With eyes like someone possessed...
"What a drag.
I did such a good job disguising myself as Kazama, and this guy saw right through me.
But he's just a human too.
Taking him over was easy."
Hino stretched both arms out toward me.
And then everything went black before my eyes...{p}

He's cute when he smiles.
...But something's off about him.{p}

That has a ring of truth to it.
I'm not sure why, but the word 'Amazak' sounds really familiar.
...Wait, that's just Kazama's name read backwards!
Kazama pulled me close by the shoulder and stepped out of the club room.{p}

"So it would, hee hee hee hee..."
I tried answering him in rhyme.{p}

"Hmm..."
At that, Kazama knit his brows.
"You're pretty good."
With that, he closed his eyes and started mumbling something.
What's he going to say this time?
"How lovely, hih hih hih hih..."
...What?
What's lovely?
And what's with the 'hih hih hih hih'?{p}

While I stood there dumbfounded, Kazama smiled brightly and said this.
"Heh, I was singing the praises of your beauty.
Talking in rhyme is fun, isn't it?
Like the poets in classical literature.
You couldn't come up with a reply, so I win."{p}
Not that I was trying to compete or anything...{p}

"{b}, which way is your house?"
Before I knew it, we'd reached the school gate.
What should I do?
There's something weird about this guy.
Will I be okay walking home with him?
But I can't exactly say goodbye right here, either...{p}

I can't say farewell.
Then at least...
"Fart-well."
I tried out a gag I used to say all the time in kindergarten.
The key is how you pronounce the 'fart.'{p}

...Oh!
Kazama was looking at me with a sour face.
"{b}, did you say something?"
"N-no, nothing at all."
Phew, that was close.
If I say anything too weird, it'll get back to Hino later.
And if it spreads to everyone in the newspaper club...
I don't even want to imagine it.
"W-well, let's hurry up and go."
To cover it up, I took Kazama's hand and started walking.
Do I really have no choice but to go home with him like this?{p}

But maybe that shadiness is part of his charm.
Kazama's kind of an interesting person, isn't he?{p}

"My house is just up ahead."
"I see.
The pervert's ghost doesn't seem to be showing up, so I guess we're safe for today, anyway.
...But I'm worried about tomorrow and after.
Maybe we should walk home together every day from now on..."
Kazama was muttering to himself.
How serious is this guy, really?
I just can't tell.
As I walked along thinking about that, someone suddenly grabbed my shoulder from behind.{p}

"Eek!"
"Heh heh, surprised?"
Kazama was laughing at having startled me.
"What is it?"
"Ahaha, did you think I was the pervert's ghost?"
"I was just surprised because you grabbed me so suddenly."{p}

...Honestly, Kazama.
I'm almost home.
Without realizing it, I'd sped up.
"{b}, wai..."
My shoulder was grabbed again.
"Kazama, stop scaring m...!"{p}

When I turned around, a completely different man was looking down at me.
Who is he?
It's so dark I can't make out his face.
"Kyaaaaaah☆"{p}

"{b}★"
Kazama caught up right away.
"You bastard!
What do you think you're doing★"
He tore the man away from me and punched him as hard as he could.{p}

The man was knocked flying and landed on his backside.
But right away, he let out a groan and fought back.
"Are you the pervert's ghost?
Give it up and pass on already!"
Kazama didn't flinch one bit.
He's so strong...{p}

After a while, Kazama came over to me, brushing the dust off himself.
"It's all right now."
The man lay on the ground, not moving a muscle.
What on earth was that man?
The pervert's ghost, like Kazama said?
Or just some creep?
Either way, he'd almost done who-knows-what to me.
"That was close.
This is why I don't want to let a girl walk home alone at this hour."{p}

Kazama walked me all the way to my front door.
"See you, {b}."
Kazama's a strange person.
Just when I think he's all jokes, he goes and seriously protects me...{p}

And then, the next day.
I got up early and headed for school.
I have to write a report on yesterday for Hino.
And then there's Kazama...
Which class is he in?
I want to thank him for yesterday.
A cool breeze brushed past my cheek.
The birds were chirping sweetly.
What a refreshing day... hm?
There was a man collapsed by the side of the road.
It's the man Kazama knocked down yesterday.
Was he here all night...? Oh☆{p}

A cold rain poured through my heart.
Then an indescribable dread came over me.
His face is so battered out of shape from Kazama's beating that I can't be sure, but...
If my instincts aren't wrong, this man is...
This man sprawled spread-eagle with a bloody nose is...
"Sir!"
It's my homeroom teacher~!{p}

K-Kazama...!
How could you make a mistake like that?
...No, I'm partly to blame too.
Even if it was dark, I didn't recognize my own teacher.
What a wonder.
Maybe that settles the school's seventh wonder.{p}
"W-would you like to rest at my house?"{p}

"Oh, are you sure?"
Kazama suddenly broke into a big smile.
...Ugh.
Did I just get tricked...?
But there's no backing out now.{p}

"How do you do? My name is Kazama.
I've come to see {b} home, since club activities kept her late today."
"Kazama, is it?
Thank you very much."
Dad smiled.
"Please, do come in.
{b}, why don't you serve him some tea?"{p}

"Thank you very much."
...Honestly, Kazama.
When he's being polite like that, he seems so refined.
He's somehow different from how he was a little while ago.{p}

"Wow, this tea sure is good."
The moment he stepped into my room, Kazama broke into a casual grin.
I guess this is what they call being two-faced.
"{b}, got any playing cards or anything?"
"Huh?"
"Let's play."
"...Kazama, weren't you cursed by a ghost and suffering from a stomachache?"
"Hm?
Uh, well, when I drank the tea you made me, it went away."
"Uh-huh..."{p}

"Ah, you don't believe me.
Ghosts really do exist, you know.{p}

Well, never mind that.
Let's play cards."
"......"
In the end, we played cards.
After we'd played for a good while, Kazama came out with this.{p}
"We're a couple with your parents' blessing now, huh."{p}
